changelog:
Add on-the-fly adaptive stream proxy and enhance preview/player support, plus UI typography customizations and minor Electron fixes. Key changes:

- routes/download.py: improve HLS detection (skip .ts segments, strip BOM/newlines before checking), print tracebacks on errors, and add /api/proxy/stream_adaptive endpoint that uses ffmpeg to mux video-only and audio-only URLs into a single stream (supports mp4/webm, start_time param).
- routes/info.py: include audio_url on video option objects when available to enable adaptive muxing from the UI.
- static/js/main.js: add history date formatting, font-family customizer, richer font-size scaling, persistence of new settings, adaptive preview state and seek logic (seekAdaptiveVideo), keyboard controls and detection for adaptive (separate audio/video) previews, and wire preview to the new stream_adaptive endpoint for YouTube-style adaptive formats.
- static/css/styles.css and templates/index.html: expose font vars and scale (rem-based sizing), convert many sizes/gaps to rems, add responsive font-scale handling, and add additional Google fonts & a font-family selector in the customizer.
- electron/main.js: suppress noisy Chromium/DevTools protocol warnings via log-level and fix Windows installer spawn to target the running exe name when taskkilling processes.

These changes enable better handling of DASH/adaptive streams (e.g. YouTube video+audio), improved UX for typography/customization, and more robust HLS detection/preview behavior.
